content: The official website for the anime based on Wookjakga 's A Returner's Magic Should Be Special ( Kikansha no Mahō wa Tokubetsu Desu in Japanese) Korean web comic unveiled on Sunday the opening theme song's artists, October premiere, and teaser visual for the anime's second season.

title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special Season 2 Premieres October 2026, FLOW Returns for Opening Theme
content: The second season of A Returner’s Magic Should Be Special has been confirmed to premiere in October 2026. A new teaser visual and PV trailer were also released alongside the announcement. Studio Arvo Animation is back to animate, with Taishi Kawaguchi returning as director.
